newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-MANSELL SAYS HE COULD BE TEMPTED TO RETURN TO F1.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-MANSELL SAYS HE COULD BE TEMPTED TO RETURN TO F1.

text.p: Former world champion Nigel Mansell said on Thursday he could be tempted to return to Formula One if the right offer came along.
Mansell, winner of the world title in 1992, told BBC radio: "To go for another world title or to compete at the highest level is very exciting.
"My focus at the moment is on golf but motor racing still very much burns in my heart...my time is not up.
"There are a a couple of things which are very tempting."

Mansell, who insisted he had not retired from motor racing but merely "stood down" from the sport, said he was delighted by fellow Briton Damon Hill's world championship success with Williams, the team with which he won his title.
